title: Commitment record (v1)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a Cadence queue item (queue/<item-id>.md). This is the Overture → Cadence handoff contract: Overture emits it as its terminal artifact at handoff; Cadence consumes it at t=0 and mutates it thereafter. The prose body below the frontmatter carries the scope summary (explicit ins AND outs) and links to spec/thread — not validated here. Source: cadence-spec.md §5.1.

id.description: Kebab-case item id; also the queue filename stem (queue/<id>.md).

size.description: Coarse, deliberately. No story points anywhere in the core (spec §7).

dependency_profile.description: Load-bearing for forecasting: coordination cost does not compress with skill (spec §7).

owner.description: Roster id from the workspace's config/team.yaml.

external_deadline.description: Only if a real external date exists. Requires deadline_authority.

deadline_authority.description: Who set the deadline and via what channel, e.g. "VP Product, via PM (Slack 7/28)".

scenario.description: Link to the scenario record if this commitment's scope was negotiated against a deadline (§5.2).

assumptions.description: Referenced by assumption_broken ledger events via id.

owner.description: Whose calendar the unblock sits on — may be outside the team (e.g. legal@).

preconditions.description: Typed blockers with owners (§9.3). An unresolved precondition past its forecast shifts the dependent item and writes the causal ledger event.

basis.description: What makes the estimate defensible, e.g. "team median, size M, cross-team profile (n=12)" or "seeded" during cold start.

forecast.description: Computed by Cadence; absent on a freshly handed-off record until the first calendar walk.
